item.title: Spotlight On: Five things to watch at ASCO
item.description: The world’s largest oncology meeting begins on Friday, May 29. Stay tuned for comprehensive coverage of the topics, trends and themes being discussed in and around the conference.In the meantime, here is a look at some of the higher-profile readouts with practice-changing potential that are set to be presented over the next week at the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) meeting…

item.title: Spotlight On: Merck & Co. and Kelun threaten to rain on ivonescimab's ASCO parade
item.description: Impressive data for the antibody-drug conjugate sacituzumab tirumotecan raise new questions about the best successor to Keytruda in lung cancer.

item.title: KOL Views Preview: Key takeaways from J&J's DUET-CD data for biologic combos in IBD
item.description: FirstWord is speaking with leading IBD expert about J&J's DUET findings, what the future holds for JNJ-4804 and what the results mean for other biologics combinations.
